LanguageData.AOPatch_Intro: This page controls the compatibility layer between Atmosphere Overhaul and other temperature mods. Modules are independent; a missing target is skipped automatically.
LanguageData.AOPatch_MasterDesc: Master switch. When off, no module installs any patch - a one-click rollback without uninstalling the mod.
LanguageData.AOPatch_TargetsHeader: Target modules (bracketed text is the current state)
LanguageData.AOPatch_Module_GoodClimateDesc: When Good Climate closes a vent because of vacuum, also set the Atmosphere Overhaul air-vent speed limit to 0. Vanilla never links the two, so a "closed" vent still leaks.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Module_VTEDesc: Reserved module. Currently presence/type diagnostics only; its climate devices will later be bound to Atmosphere Overhaul continuous sources.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Module_CCCDesc: Reserved module. It currently declares no 1.7 support, so on 1.7 it is usually not loaded and this module is skipped.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Module_OmniDesc: Reserved module. Will make the OmniBiosphere write into the real Atmosphere Overhaul temperature field instead of only overriding reads.
LanguageData.AOPatch_VerboseLoggingDesc: Write per-module details to Player.log for troubleshooting. Keep it off normally.
LanguageData.AOPatch_NeedReapply: Switches changed. Click the button below or restart the game to apply.
LanguageData.AOPatch_Footer: If Atmosphere Overhaul later ships its own support for a mod, disable that module and restart; other modules are unaffected.
